lines.x: ADNOC CEO Sultan Al Jaber stated that the global energy system has drained nearly 1 billion barrels of crude inventories and eroded supply buffers following traffic disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.

Brent crude oil futures for December delivery dropped nearly 3% to $110 as investors monitored the situation in the Middle East and anticipated potential diplomatic progress between the United States and Iran.
A record-breaking hack on the Binance cryptocurrency exchange has prompted questions regarding platform security and impacted investor confidence.
The Dubai oil benchmark curve slipped into contango for the first time since July as rising physical flows from Middle East Gulf producers exceed current demand.
